scope: Observable and inference-map semantics for the local distance ladder, Planck CMB and DESI DR2 BAO; no GU cosmology or new H0 estimate is constructed.

measured_inputs: geometric anchor distances from parallaxes, NGC 4258 masers and LMC detached eclipsing binaries
primary_sources.inference_map: geometric anchors -> Cepheid calibration -> SN Ia absolute magnitude -> magnitude-redshift fit -> H0
primary_sources.licensed_claim: A geometrically anchored empirical distance ladder determines H0 = 73.04 +/- 1.04 km/s/Mpc in its baseline fit, including systematics.
primary_sources.ceiling: H0 is fitted through calibration and nuisance assumptions; it is not a raw detector output or an assumption-free quantity, but neither is the ladder 'nothing measured'.

primary_sources.inference_map: CMB spectra + base-LambdaCDM forward model -> physical densities and sound horizon -> inferred late-Universe H0
primary_sources.licensed_claim: The angular acoustic scale is measured to 0.03 percent precision; assuming base LambdaCDM, H0 = 67.4 +/- 0.5 km/s/Mpc is inferred.
primary_sources.ceiling: The Planck H0 value cannot be imported after changing the cosmological forward model; GU must predict theta_* or the spectra from its own background and perturbations.

measured_inputs: BAO feature positions in galaxy, quasar and Lyman-alpha clustering
BAO scaling parameters alpha_iso and alpha_AP
distance ratios D_V/r_d, D_M/r_d, D_H/r_d and D_M/D_H
primary_sources.inference_map: BAO peak fits -> distance ratios; within flat LambdaCDM the joint fit constrains Omega_m and H0*r_d
primary_sources.licensed_claim: DESI DR2 reports calibrated distance ratios across redshift and does not measure H0 alone.
primary_sources.ceiling: An H0 value requires a sound-horizon calibration or other early-Universe information; a GU test must compute its own r_d and distances.

rejected_inference: all routes infer H0 -> no published H0 determination contains measured empirical content
precise_impossibility: The measured-versus-derived binary cannot carry the B3 disposition because the three routes have different measured carriers, calibration maps and model dependence; it neither excuses GU nor licenses one compressed H0 target as universal.
corrected_evaluation_packet: construct an action-owned background, perturbations and fixed initial data
compute r_s(z_*), theta_*, r_d and DESI distance ratios without importing comparator calibration
compute the low-redshift luminosity-distance/redshift relation and validate or rerun the local-ladder compression
evaluate CMB, BAO and local-ladder likelihoods separately through one common forward model
